question: A quantity cannot be parsed. What preserves the strongest audit trail?
options: Keep the raw value in a reject ledger with a reason
Replace it silently with zero
Delete the entire input without recording counts
Treat parsing failure as a successful sale
why: A reject ledger preserves what was received and why it was excluded, allowing counts to reconcile without inventing a valid value.

question: Two local plans produce the same total. What follows?
options: Power Query definitely folded every step
They agree for the checked fixture
All connectors support the same M operations
Their production runtimes will match
why: Equality on a bounded dataset is local correctness evidence, not proof about a separate vendor engine or performance.

question: What happens when a category-by-month grid is unpivoted?
options: It becomes order-line sales automatically
All months are added into one date
Monthly columns become category-month records
Every source key becomes unique automatically
why: Unpivot changes the representation and grain. It does not establish equivalence to a transaction fact table.

question: What does the declared grain explain?
options: The preferred chart color
The workspace password policy
The file extension
The business meaning of one fact row
why: Grain identifies the event and level of detail represented by a record; it determines which aggregations make sense.

question: Hardware and North filters both reach Sales. Which rows qualify in this simple model?
options: Rows satisfying both filters
Rows satisfying either filter alone
Every row twice
Only rows without product keys
why: Independent dimension restrictions intersect at the facts. Adding separately filtered totals would double-count or include ineligible rows.

question: A lookup key is duplicated. What is the sound teaching response?
options: Assume relationships repair it
Flag the key-quality failure before accepting the result
Hide the duplicate in the chart
Count the extra join rows as new sales
why: A unique-key dimension is a declared assumption. A violated assumption should produce visible evidence, not an unexplained total.

question: A report region selection changes. Which expectation fits the teaching case?
options: Every historical unit price is rewritten
The file becomes a deployed semantic model
A selected aggregate changes while stored line amounts remain fixed
Calculated columns must all become measures
why: A query selection changes the evaluated population, not the source line facts in this Import-oriented example.

question: What does a new same-column filter normally do inside CALCULATE without KEEPFILTERS?
options: Always intersect with the old value
Erase all filters everywhere
Modify source rows permanently
Replace that existing column restriction
why: The example concerns replacement on the same filtered column. KEEPFILTERS changes the combination to intersection; other context is not automatically erased.

question: Which expression answers revenue per unit over the whole selected population?
options: Total revenue divided by total units
Unweighted average of line prices in every case
Sum of product identifiers
Maximum unit price minus number of lines
why: The numerator and denominator use the same population and weight by units. A mean of line prices instead weights each line equally.

question: Why include dates without sales in the teaching calendar?
options: Every missing date is a hidden sale
The analytical time structure is separate from observed events
It guarantees exam readiness
It removes the need for a date role
why: An uninterrupted calendar can represent periods consistently even when no transactions occur on some dates.

question: What makes a year-over-year comparison potentially misleading?
options: Comparing complete equal months
Stating the cutoff date
Comparing a partial current period with an unexplained full prior period
Naming the denominator
why: Different observation windows can dominate the apparent change. Declare and align periods before interpreting growth.

question: Stock balances are 10 on Monday and 12 on Tuesday. Under a Tuesday closing rule, what is closing stock?
options: The number of calendar dates
why: A stock balance is a snapshot. Summing balances across dates double-counts inventory instead of reporting the closing position.

question: Hardware is 9000 out of all-category revenue 16000. What is its share?
options: 100% regardless of denominator
why: Divide 9000 by 16000. A 100% answer instead describes Hardware relative to a Hardware-only selected population.

question: A report plan has an alt-text field. What has been established?
options: That a screen reader passed every visual
Only that the checked field is present
That tab order is correct in Power BI
That all color contrasts are adequate
why: A presence check does not evaluate rendered behavior or the quality of the description.

question: What should accompany a changing percentage?
options: Only a decorative icon
A hidden date range
An understandable denominator and selection scope
An unexplained color
why: Readers need the reference population to understand why a share changes and what comparison it supports.

question: A visual reaggregates an unchanged copied snapshot. Which total should it use?
options: The later source total automatically
Zero because data is copied
A random total chosen by the chart
The snapshot total of 12000 cents
why: Requerying the same copied population does not add records that were never imported into that snapshot.

question: What does the invented outage scenario establish?
options: The behavior of this bounded local source-dependence model
A real service uptime guarantee
That DirectQuery has no caches
That Direct Lake always falls back to SQL
why: The scenario distinguishes conceptual dependence on a source from copied-data availability, without testing a provider.

question: Which statement about the exercise is accurate?
options: A Fabric capacity was configured
Direct Lake framing is discussed but not modeled
A gateway was installed
A scheduled refresh was published
why: The workshop is local and bounded. Real service configuration and Direct Lake behavior remain separate work.

question: Which workspace-role choice is unsafe for a person who must be restricted by RLS in this scenario?
options: Viewer with the intended row role
A tested restricted Viewer
Contributor
A read-only Viewer assignment
why: The documented workspace RLS restriction does not apply to Contributor, Member or Admin roles.

question: What happens when the fixed Viewer has both North and South region roles?
options: Only the smaller region remains
Both roles cancel all access
The source records are permanently deleted
The union includes all 16000 cents
why: These allowed-role populations union, so an additional role broadens the visible rows.

question: Why is this local command not a security boundary?
options: The complete fixture remains readable and the code is modifiable
All permission reasoning is useless
A green test automatically grants workspace access
Python establishes cloud identities automatically
why: Local set filtering can illustrate policy but cannot protect a dataset that the learner can directly inspect.

question: Which conclusion is supported by a passing capstone receipt?
options: All Power BI capabilities were executed
The bounded local reconciliation passed for its synthetic inputs
The learner is certified-ready
The report is safe to publish with real data
why: The evidence supports only the computations and checks that actually ran, under the recorded fixture and scope.

question: Which period reconciliation is expected?
options: 6000 plus 10000 equals 12000 cents
January alone proves a full-year source
6000 plus 10000 equals 16000 cents
A percentage replaces the monetary total
why: January and February partition these six facts. The complete calendar does not imply that transactions exist on every date.

question: What should the objective-guide mapping communicate?
options: A fabricated percentage of exam readiness
That Python executes DAX
That all objectives have been implemented
Selected conceptual links and remaining product gaps
why: A dated partial mapping is useful for further planning, but coverage and readiness need evidence this workshop does not provide.
